_comment: Facts about this person and this machine, shared by every worktime script. Copy to ~/.config/worktime/profile.json. Written by the worktime-setup skill; safe to edit by hand.
_work_url_keywords: Any address containing one of these words is work -- the wiki, the ticket tracker, the training site and the SSO portal, without naming each one. Matched against the address only, so searching the word is not work. Omit the key to keep the default.
_work_localhost_ports: Ports on this machine that serve the work app in development. A tab on one of them is work: nothing else in localhost:3000/dashboard says so. Omit the key to keep the default of 3000-3005.
_focus_extra_apps: Bundle ids to count as work on top of the built-in list, which names Slack, Zoom, Zed, Granola and GitHub Desktop. Obsidian is deliberately absent from that list because one vault held both meeting notes and a grocery list -- if yours is only ever the job, add 'md.obsidian' here and its foreground time counts. Omit the key to change nothing.
_long_read: Turn this on if your work is READING rather than clicking. Normally a page earns credit at the moment you switch to it, which suits a day of quick navigation -- hundreds of switches, each one holding the day open. Read a single article for forty minutes and that produces one switch and thirty-nine minutes of apparent silence. Enabled, a page you are sitting on keeps earning, but only while the machine says somebody is still there: scrolling counts, so a reader stays credited and a tab left open in an empty room stops within max_idle_sec. Leave it out or set enabled false to keep the default behaviour.

long_read._max_idle_sec: How long you may go without touching anything before the page you are on stops counting. 300 is five minutes -- long enough for a dense paragraph, short enough that a parked tab stops earning quickly. The ordinary limit is 120.
long_read._stride_sec: How often a continuing read earns again. Keep it under five minutes or the events will not join up and a long read comes back as scattered minutes.

_google_work_account: The account number in Google URLs: drive.google.com/drive/u/1/home is account 1. Set it only when a separate work Google account exists -- then that account's Gmail, Calendar and Drive count as work and the personal account's do not. With one Google account there is nothing to tell apart; omit the key. docs.google.com is the exception: it serves no account index, so with this key set every doc counts under either account.
